original_evidence: Gather available witnesses, material evidence, correspondence and archival provenance
Check whether apparently corroborating records are independent or derive from a common source
Keep composition, revision, assembly and custody sequences distinct; do not substitute narrative order for any of them
Mark unsupported intervals as gaps and retain competing sequences where links conflict or remain ambiguous
neutral_evidence: Gather available witnesses, material evidence, correspondence and archival provenance records
Check whether records that appear to corroborate one another are independent or derive from a common source
do not substitute the order of the story's narrative for any of them
Mark unsupported intervals as gaps
Retain competing sequences where links conflict or remain ambiguous
operation_preserved.rationale: Every operational step in the original (gather, record identification and date type, cross-check transitions, independence check, arrange chronology with relative order or ranges, keep four sequences distinct, mark gaps, retain competing sequences, seek further evidence, stop) appears in the numbered action list with the same objects and conditions. The state content (partially unknown sequence, availability not assumed, working assumption under test) is carried in the procedure field. Differences are wording only.

original_evidence: impose compatible chronological constraints on their transitions
could support a local revision sequence, subject to copying and identification checks
Assembly links would require compatible evidence concerning the joining or ordering of units
Conflicting dates, ambiguous identifications, dependent records and missing intermediate witnesses
neutral_evidence: impose compatible chronological constraints on the transitions between them
together these could support a local revision sequence, subject to checks on copying and on identification
compatible evidence that concerns the joining or ordering of units
conflicting dates, ambiguous identifications, records that depend on one another, and missing intermediate witnesses
signal_preserved.rationale: The supporting signal, the three-part illustrative example with its conditional 'could support' and its copying/identification caveat, the assembly-link requirement, and the four signals of unresolved transitions are all retained with the same hedging and scope.

original_evidence: warrant a bounded reconstruction of documented revision and assembly
Prefer a sequence only insofar as it accommodates the supported constraints without requiring unsupported transitions
it does not alone date the reading's first composition
only where an additional supported link connects it to revision or assembly
neutral_evidence: justify a bounded reconstruction of the documented revision and assembly
A sequence is preferred to the extent that it accommodates the supported constraints without requiring unsupported transitions
by itself it does not date when the reading was first composed
solely where an additional supported link connects that evidence to revision or assembly
inference_preserved.rationale: The bounded warrant, the conditional preference rule, the fallback to an ordered subset or competing sequences, the three-way classification of transitions (established within available evidence, provisional, unresolved), the conditional dated-witness inference with its negative limit, and the custody/location restriction are all preserved with equivalent conditionality.

original_evidence: Records and witnesses may be lost, inaccessible, anonymous, forged, mistaken or copied from one another
textual difference alone need not determine revision direction
Absence of a witness or record does not establish absence of revision, transfer or rearrangement
A continuous-looking chronology may conceal undocumented or misidentified transitions
a local alteration cannot establish the whole novel's formation
no actual sequence or practitioner consensus is established by this packet
neutral_evidence: records and witnesses may be lost, inaccessible, anonymous, forged, mistaken, or copied from one another
a textual difference alone need not determine the direction of revision
Absence of a witness or record does not establish absence of revision, transfer or rearrangement
A chronology that appears continuous may contain undocumented or misidentified transitions
A local alteration cannot establish the formation of the whole work
The packet establishes no actual sequence and no practitioner consensus
limit_preserved.rationale: Each stated limit, including the negative inference limits (absence of record, textual difference alone, local alteration), the ambiguity of identifications and material evidence, the scoped-hypothesis reporting condition with its four explicit assumption types, and the no-sequence/no-consensus disclaimer, is present. 'may conceal' becoming 'may contain' alongside 'appears continuous' and 'whole novel's formation' becoming 'formation of the whole work' are wording changes that do not drop a limit.

original_evidence: Stop extending that link when accessible evidence cannot distinguish the alternatives, and state what further evidence would be needed
neutral_evidence: Stop extending that link when accessible evidence cannot distinguish the alternatives, and state what further evidence would be needed
Stopping rule: extension of an unresolved link stops when accessible evidence cannot distinguish the alternatives, at which point the needed further evidence is stated
stopping_condition_preserved.rationale: The single stopping condition in the original is link-scoped and triggered by accessible evidence failing to distinguish alternatives. The paraphrase reproduces it with the same scope, trigger and accompanying statement duty, and adds no further stopping rule.

original_evidence: For an unresolved link, seek additional witnesses, material inspection or relevant dated correspondence and provenance
state what further evidence would be needed
neutral_evidence: For any unresolved link, the specified follow-up is to seek additional witnesses, material inspection, or relevant dated correspondence and provenance
the follow-up is to state what further evidence would be needed to distinguish them
No further follow-up beyond these is specified
next_inquiry_preserved.rationale: The original has no separate next-inquiry field; its follow-up content sits in the operation. The paraphrase carries over exactly those two follow-ups and explicitly marks anything further as unspecified, so no follow-up is lost or invented.

original_evidence: using relative order or date ranges where exact dates are unsupported
Cross-check proposed transitions through variants, deletions, insertions, handwriting, paper features and dated context
Identify which transitions are established within the available evidence, which are provisional and which remain unresolved
neutral_evidence: chronology expressed as exact dates, relative order or date ranges according to what the evidence supports
transitions between textual states or units, each evaluated as an individual link
Attributes recorded per trace
Link statuses: established within available evidence, provisional, unresolved
no_added_operational_content.rationale: The problem_decomposition field and the procedure summary reorganise content already present in the original state, operation, inference and limit fields. The mention of exact dates is implied by the original's fallback wording; per-link evaluation and per-trace attributes restate the original's cross-checking, recording and independence steps. No new step, threshold, tool, evidence type or decision rule is introduced.

original_evidence: Additional witnesses, correspondence and custody records are possible sources of dated traces
neutral_evidence: Additional witnesses, correspondence and custody records are treated as possible sources of dated traces
Illustrative case given in the mapping
no_source_imagery.rationale: The paraphrase names no source discipline and uses no metaphor drawn from one. Terms such as witnesses, custody, traces and provenance appear in the original as descriptions of target evidence about the draft and are retained as target entities. The phrase 'given in the mapping' refers to the packet, not to a source domain. Target entities (leaves, sections, variants, revision layers, draft units, textual states) are retained.

original_evidence: Report conclusions as a scoped scholarly hypothesis
no actual sequence or practitioner consensus is established by this packet
neutral_evidence: conclusions are reported as a scoped scholarly hypothesis
The packet establishes no actual sequence and no practitioner consensus
no_verdict_language.rationale: The paraphrase describes behaviour, signals, warrants and limits only. It makes no claim that the procedure is ordinary, native, novel, unorthodox, creative, a formalization, a departure, or that it adds or lacks a warrant. The no-consensus sentence is a scope disclaimer carried over from the original, not an evaluation of the procedure.

uncertainty: The packet does not name the source discipline, so the no_source_imagery check rests on the absence of any discipline name or evident metaphor in the paraphrase; terms such as 'witnesses', 'custody' and 'traces' could be source-derived, but they appear identically in the original as target evidence types and were treated as target entities.

The paraphrase replaces 'the whole novel's formation' with 'the formation of the whole work' and never uses the word 'novel'; this was judged a wording change because the surviving draft and its units remain the stated objects, but it is a slight generalisation of the target entity.

The problem_decomposition field has no direct counterpart in the original five-field mapping; its content was judged to be a reorganisation of existing material (for example, independence framed as a per-trace attribute and transitions 'each evaluated as an individual link') and not added operational content, though this framing is marginally more explicit than the original.
'may conceal' is rendered as 'may contain'; the sense of hidden transitions is carried by 'appears continuous', but the nuance is slightly weaker.
